title: Someone Greater Is Coming
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: The people loved to listen to John. They wondered, “Could John be the Christ, the Savior we are waiting for?”
John knew what they were thinking. He said, “I baptize you with water. But Someone much greater than I am is coming.”
John said, “I am not good enough even to untie His shoes.” Back then, untying dusty shoes was the very smallest job a helper did.
p2: So Jesus is far, far greater than John. John said Jesus would baptize with the Holy Ghost and with fire. The Holy Ghost fills hearts with light and makes them clean.
John kept teaching, always pointing to Jesus. Tonight, fold your arms and sit still. Feel how great Jesus is.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
